arguments.body:
### Weekly Real-World Testing Run — 2026-05-09

This weekly run could not complete a corpus validation. The **dollarlint-repo MCP server** was not reachable (port 8080 not bound), which is required to build dollarlint, clone repositories, and run validation. The server requires Docker-in-Docker to launch its `golang:1.26.3` container, which is not supported in this execution environment.

---

### Blocker Summary

| Item | Status |
|------|--------|
| dollarlint-repo MCP server | ❌ Not running (port 8080 not listening) |
| `git clone` | ❌ Blocked by bash security policy (only `git status`/`git diff` allowed) |
| `go build` | ❌ Blocked by bash security policy |
| `node` (to call MCP CLI bridge) | ❌ Blocked by bash security policy |

The bash tool in this workflow is restricted to: `date`, `jq`, `git status`, `git diff`, `git diff --stat`, `sed`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `wc`. All other executables are blocked by the sandbox security policy in non-interactive mode.

---

### Intended Corpus (5 repos — all fresh, not in history)

| Repository | Ecosystem | Clone URL |
|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| gitea | Go/TypeScript | https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea.git |
| prettier | JavaScript/Node | https://github.com/prettier/prettier.git |
| fastapi | Python | https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi.git |
| neovim | C/Lua | https://github.com/neovim/neovim.git |
| pnpm | TypeScript/Node | https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm.git |

These were selected from the default pool after excluding 27 previously-tested repositories (ansible, avalonia, cargo, deno, django, efcore, express, flask, flutter-samples, fmt, grafana, homebrew-brew, julia, laravel-framework, maven, phoenix, prometheus, rails, react, requests, svelte, terraform, tokio, typescript, vite, vue-core, zig).

---

### DollarLint State

- **Revision**: `[REDACTED]`
- **Working tree**: clean (nothing to commit)
- **Prior results file**: `reports/real-world-results.json` (4 entries)
- **Output artifact**: not generated (run did not start)

---

### Next Concrete Fix

The workflow (`weekly-real-world-testing.md`) configures `dollarlint-repo` as a Docker-sidecar MCP server (`container: golang:1.26.3`). To fix this:

1. **Verify Docker-in-Docker support** in the GitHub Actions runner for agentic workflows (`gh-aw`), or
2. **Re-configure** the `dollarlint-repo` MCP server to run as a native host process (not in a container), or
3. **Expand the bash allowlist** in `weekly-real-world-testing.md` to include `git clone`, `go build`, and `dollarlint` so the agent can manually run the corpus pipeline without the MCP server.

<details>
<summary>Raw diagnostics</summary>

- `cat /proc/net/tcp`: Port 8080 (0x1F90) not found in listening state
- `cat /home/runner/work/_temp/gh-aw/mcp-cli/manifest.json`: dollarlint-repo server listed at `http://host.docker.internal:8080/mcp/dollarlint-repo`
- MCP CLI bridge binary exists but requires `node` to invoke (blocked)
- `/opt/hostedtoolcache/go/1.26.3/x64/bin/go` exists but `go version` is blocked by policy
- Workflow run: https://github.com/dollarlint/dollarlint/actions/runs/25609301820

</details>
